NMOS cascodes make the output resistance set by the long-L PMOS mirror, so gain is about 1.7*A_p, or 52-55 dB, and f3db = GBW/A is about 85 kHz. Output DC is VDD-VSG_p, about 0.7 V. PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (17.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id (near-subthreshold at Vin=0.75)
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail": (20e-6, 12e-6, 26e-6),
    "gmidc": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # NMOS cascode
    "Lc":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "gmidp": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load
    "Lp":    (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),
    "gmidt": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # tail / bias mirror
    "vcas":  (1.02, 0.9, 1.15),      # cascode gate voltage (divider)
    "Rdiv":  (900e3, 400e3, 2e6),    # total divider resistance
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = p["Itail"] / 2.0

    # input pair: estimate tail node from its own Vgs (body effect included iteratively)
    vtail = 0.2
    for _ in range(3):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=0.25, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(0.08, vin - m1.vgs)
    # cascode: source sits at vcas - vgs_c
    vx = 0.4
    for _ in range(3):
        mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I, vds=0.3, vsb=vx)
        vx = p["vcas"] - mc.vgs
    # PMOS mirror load
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.8)
    vout_dc = vdd - mp.vgs
    mc_vds = max(0.1, vout_dc - vx)
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I, vds=mc_vds, vsb=vx)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=max(0.1, vx - vtail), vsb=vtail)
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=mp.vgs)
    # tail mirror from ibias
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], 1.0, p["Itail"], vds=max(0.1, vtail))
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], 1.0, iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    # divider: vdd - Ra - vcas - Rb - vref - Rc - vss
    R = p["Rdiv"]
    Rc = R * vin / vdd
    Rb = R * (p["vcas"] - vin) / vdd
    Ra = R - Rb - Rc

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vin", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vref", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "vcas", "x1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "vcas", "x2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M5", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.R("RS", "ibias", "nb", 1e3)
    n.R("RA", "vdd", "vcas", Ra)
    n.R("RB", "vcas", "vref", Rb)
    n.R("RC", "vref", "vss", Rc)

    # predictions
    rcas = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs + mc.gds) / (m1.gds * mc.gds)   # cascoded NMOS output resistance
    gout = mp.gds + 1.0 / rcas
    A = m1.gm / gout
    ctot = cl + mp.cdd + mc.cdd + 20e-15
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = gout / (2 * PI * ctot)
    vmin = vx + mc.vdsat + 0.05
    vmax = vdd - mp.vdsat - 0.05
    swing = vmax - vmin
    power = vdd * (iref + p["Itail"] + vdd / R)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3db, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "swing": swing}
